summary: Tested Calendar/Planning, the appointment lifecycle and reminder cron, QC Anexa 5 and the Anexa 5 register (backend + UI). Backend: new pytest suite test_planning_anexa5.py, 24 tests, 18 pass and 6 fail. These work: RBAC (401/403/200), rejecting reversed intervals, vehicle-belongs-to-client check on POST, elevator and mechanic conflicts (409), edit/move, in_lucru converting to exactly one WO (also under 4 parallel calls), confirmation notification status=simulated, cron returning 401 on missing or bad auth and 200 with the secret, X-Webhook-Id duplicate=true and a single reminder per appointment, the QC rule (mecanic gets 403 on the chief signature, N or missing items/signatures means not passed, finalizata and fiscal invoice blocked without a passed QC), and the Anexa 5 report (422/400 validation, 13 columns, C/N/NA codes, inspector filter, PDF A4 landscape 842x595 with correct diacritics checked visually, CSV with BOM, XLSX with 13 headers). UI: /planning is visible, Zi/Săptămână/Lună/Rampe views render (4 elevator columns), create via dialog, 409 conflict toast, drag & drop to another day persists, status În lucru creates the WO and shows the Comandă button, QcTab shows the 7 categories with C/N/NA and saves Promovat/Nepromovat with signatures, the Anexa 5 page has filters with errors, 13 th columns, CSV/XLSX downloads, and on mobile the table scrolls inside its container (doc width 390). Main bugs: (1) TIMEZONE: the calendar shows/edits times in UTC and saving the dialog shifts the appointment by the browser offset, (2) the PDF/Print button in the Anexa 5 UI is broken (opens a frontend route and redirects to the dashboard), (3) the day/week range starts at the current time, so earlier appointments are hidden, (4) the QC can be downgraded to N after finalization and a fiscal invoice is still issued.

critical.issue: QC can be saved again with N after the WO is already finalizata; the status stays finalizata and the fiscal invoice is issued (200). Invoicing only checks status, not qc.passed. save_qc also does not block editing on facturata/inchisa WOs.

minor.issue: used_minutes = 60 per appointment, regardless of length; total = elevators*8h no matter how long the interval is (week/month). A 2h appointment on 4 elevators shows 3% instead of 6%.
Does not check that vehicle_id belongs to client_id (POST does). Also allows editing appointments that are anulat/finalizat.

starts_at/ends_at are not parsed as datetime: 'abc'/'abd' is accepted (200). Comparisons are string-based, so offsets other than Z (e.g. +03:00) break conflict detection and the 23-25h reminder window.

No status transition validation (finalizat -> programat allowed). Conversion is not atomic (no find_one_and_update on work_order_id); the parallel test did not produce a duplicate, but a race is theoretically possible.
No Content-Disposition header (filename). XLSX: header is bold white font without fill -> invisible text on white background.
Cells are plain strings, not Paragraph: long headers ('Faruri / geamuri / parbrize') and 'Unitate · inspector' run past the column edges; the inspector signature is not shown in the PDF (name only).
Uses distinct qc.inspector_name only; legacy QCs (qc.by without inspector_name) appear in the report but cannot be filtered.

ui_bugs.issue: toLocal(value.slice(0,16)) puts a UTC ISO string into datetime-local, which is then read as local time. Reproduced in Europe/Bucharest: created at 10:00, the edit dialog shows 07:00, and Save with no changes moves it to 07:00 (-3h each save). New default and slot selection are also in UTC.
PDF/Print and Print buttons do window.open('/reports/final-inspections/pdf?...') = frontend route without /api and without auth -> redirects to the dashboard; PDF never opens from the UI.

Day/Bays: start = new Date() (current time), not midnight. Request at 21:49 -> start=18:49Z..+24h, so today's earlier appointments are not loaded. Week: Monday at the current time -> Monday morning missing, next Monday included. Month: only the 1st..1st of next month, while the view shows adjacent days.
No mechanic selector (mechanic_ids always []), so a mechanic conflict cannot be created or tested from the UI.
capacity useApi is not reloaded after save/move/status; the occupancy counter stays stale.
today = new Date().toISOString() (UTC); in Romania between 00:00 and 03:00 the default end date is yesterday.

issues: The react-big-calendar toolbar (Today/Back/Next/Day/Week/Month) is in English and has very low contrast on the dark theme
Day/Bays view: the .rbc-today light-blue background on dark theme; the time gutter labels are nearly invisible
Time grid starts at 00:00 with no scroll to working hours (scrollToTime)
Native datetime-local instead of the shadcn date/time picker

action_items: PlanningCalendar: format datetime-local values with local time (date-fns format(new Date(iso), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm")) in openNew/openEdit; re-verify in a UTC+2/+3 timezone
FinalInspectionReport: PDF/Print through api.get(blob) + URL.createObjectURL + window.open (or downloadFile 'pdf')
rangeFor: use startOfDay/startOfWeek(weekStartsOn:1)/the month grid's visible range (or onRangeChange from react-big-calendar)
Invoicing: require w.qc.passed in invoice_from_wo; in save_qc block on LOCKED and revert finalizata -> in_lucru if the QC fails
Capacity: compute real minutes (ends-starts) and total = elevators * working hours * days in the interval
PUT /appointments: check vehicle-client ownership; parse starts_at/ends_at with datetime.fromisoformat and normalize to UTC
XLSX: add PatternFill to the header; add Content-Disposition to exports; Paragraph wrapping in the PDF
Add a mechanic multiselect in the planning dialog

create_work_order_from_appointment is not atomic (read work_order_id then insert); use find_one_and_update with a work_order_id=='' condition
